brief: A workbench organizer: two storeys, bins on top, a drawer below, all edges capped.

requirements.evidence: Build has level 0 (piece:0,0,0;half-n, piece:0,0,0;half-s) and level 1 (piece:0,0,1;half-n, piece:0,0,1;half-s, piece:1,0,1;full).
No bin parts placed; check shows only piece/snap counts, no bins on upper level. Required bins not added (would use find_sockets family bin sockets on level 1).
No drawer or drawer-frame notch installed at level 0; find_sockets for drawer returned 0 offers and build has no notch/drawer refs. Drawer frame needed before drawer can be placed.
check_build reports 10 OPEN_CAP_FACE warnings (e.g. 0,0,1;*;30, 1,0,1;*;270 etc.) and LOOSE_BODY warning; capOpenFaces and lockJoints were not run.

finish.summary: Build has two storey height but lacks bins, drawer, and edge caps. No bins placed on top, no drawer placed below (required notch frame missing), and 10 faces remain uncapped with joints unlocked.
